reason: A names the Majestic and Ruth Albers, and it promises that every pledge is returned in full if the $85,000 isn't reached. That promise matters most to me after the last campaign ended in refunds. B still has a '[Cinema Name]' placeholder, makes no refund promise and leaves out the $11,000 already pledged by businesses.
